findings.location: content.body.titleUk: "Дієслова, неправильні в теперішньому часі, в імперфекті правильні"; content.body.ruleUk: "Зміни, які дієслово має в теперішньому часі (puedo, quiero, tengo, hago), в імперфекті не відбуваються: основа береться з інфінітива."
findings.description: The unqualified generalization also includes ser, ir and ver, which are irregular in both tenses. The listed examples are correct, but the statement needs an explicit restriction.
findings.suggestion: Restrict the statement to the listed verb patterns and explicitly exclude ser, ir and ver.

items.reviewerAnswer: podía, quería, pensaba, jugaba, volvía, pedía, tenía, hacía, salía, decía. Present irregularity does not generally carry into the imperfect, but ser, ir and ver are exceptions.
items.notes: All imperfect forms listed in scope are correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, conjugation tables for ser, ir and ver: present and imperfect indicative (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: "Antes mis hijos ___ en el parque por la tarde. (jugar)"; context.taughtBefore maps "imperfecto.regular-ar.singular" and "jugaba", but no plural -ar imperfect formation.
findings.description: Producing jugaban requires the third-person plural ending -aban. This recently introduced imperfect formation is not documented in the prerequisite mapping or supplied in a hint.
findings.suggestion: Document prior teaching of imperfecto.regular-ar.plural, including -aban, or teach that ending before this independent task.

items.notes: This identifies a gap in this case's prerequisite evidence; it does not establish that the actual earlier lesson omitted plural forms.
sources: Course contract rule 1: the prerequisite mapping must establish the forms and constructions required to answer.

findings.location: task.errors[1].feedbackUk: "Форма на -g- (hago) буває лише в теперішньому часі. В імперфекті: hacía."
findings.description: The unqualified restriction of the g-form to the present tense is misleading: the hag- stem also occurs in formal imperatives such as haga and hagan. The relevant rule is that this stem does not carry into the imperfect.
findings.suggestion: Explain specifically that the present stem hag- is not used in the imperfect: hacer → hacía.

items.notes: The answer key itself is correct.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, hacer conjugation table: present subjunctive and imperative forms haga, hagan (from memory).

findings.location: task.options[0].feedbackUk: "Форма на -g- (tengo) буває лише в теперішньому часі. В імперфекті: tenía."
findings.description: The explanation overgeneralizes: the teng- stem also occurs in formal imperatives such as tenga and tengan. Its absence from the imperfect does not mean it occurs only in present-tense forms.
findings.suggestion: Limit the explanation to the contrast being taught: the present stem teng- does not carry into the imperfect; tener → tenía.

sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, tener conjugation table: present subjunctive and imperative forms tenga, tengan (from memory).

findings.location: task.errors[1].feedbackUk: "Форма на -g- (tengo) буває лише в теперішньому часі. В імперфекті: tenías."
findings.description: The statement incorrectly generalizes the g-stem's distribution. Formal imperative forms such as tenga and tengan also contain teng-. Only its transfer into the imperfect should be ruled out.
findings.suggestion: Explain that the present teng- stem is not retained in the imperfect: tener → tenías.

sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, tener conjugation table: present subjunctive and imperative forms tenga, tengan (from memory).

findings.location: task.prompt[1].text: "Mi hermana vivía en Valencia. Tenía un piso pequeño en el centro."; task.options[2].feedbackUk: "Контекст тут достатній: друге речення без підмета продовжує розповідь про сестру."
findings.description: Subject continuity strongly favors the sister, but the omitted subject of tenía is not explicitly fixed. A first-person narrator reading remains possible. The task does not distinguish the most natural interpretation from a uniquely determined interpretation.
findings.suggestion: Clarify whether the question asks for the most natural reading, or supply context that explicitly establishes the second sentence's subject before finalizing the key.

items.reviewerAnswer: b is the natural continuation reading; c is defensible if the question requires a uniquely established referent, since tenía can also mean yo tenía.
items.notes: The Spanish sentences are correct; the uncertainty concerns how categorical the interpretation should be.
sources: Packet verdict definition for uncertain: unresolved alternative readings, including an underdetermined referent.
RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 33, subject omission and contextual interpretation of omitted subjects (from memory).

findings.location: content.body.blocks[2].text: "Дієслова, неправильні в теперішньому часі, в імперфекті правильні: основа з інфінітива."
findings.description: As a standalone reference statement, this generalizes beyond the correct examples: ser, ir and ver are irregular in the present and also irregular in the imperfect.
findings.suggestion: Restrict the statement to the listed verbs or explicitly state the exceptions ser, ir and ver.

items.reviewerAnswer: comía, comías, comía, comíamos, comíais, comían; corresponding vivir and tener forms use the same endings. The listed present-irregular verbs have regular imperfect forms.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, conjugation tables for ser, ir and ver: present and imperfect indicative (from memory).
